pois.name: Boss's motor park
pois.note: The boss's park, about 200 m west of Ladi Lane Parts Market, across Ring Road. His boys collect its levy at his post at the market's west mouth. Tunde gets the bike here on 'work and pay'.

pois.name: The gate
pois.note: Opening. Where the boss pulls Tunde out of the mob.

pois.name: Under the Bridge
pois.note: Touts, pickpockets, night food. Lawless after dark.

pois.name: The boss's office
pois.note: The first cutscene (owner, 16 Oct): a dingy, makeshift bus-park office. A converted container or a zinc-walled shed: a peeling church calendar, a bare bulb, a standing fan that rattles, a desk with the ledger, plastic chairs, a padlock on the door. Reused all game: remittances, "Abeg, this money is not going down", the debt line by line.
